animals.name: Lion
animals.description: The lion is a large wild cat known as the 'King of the Jungle', native to the grasslands of Africa.

animals.name: Tiger
animals.description: The tiger is the largest cat species, recognized by its distinctive orange coat with black stripes.

animals.name: Cheetah
animals.description: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, capable of reaching speeds up to 70 mph in short bursts.

animals.name: Panther
animals.description: Panther is a common name for large black-coated big cats, typically melanistic leopards or jaguars.

animals.name: Leopard
animals.description: The leopard is a big cat known for its spotted coat and remarkable climbing ability.

animals.name: Giraffe
animals.description: The giraffe is the tallest living land animal, known for its extremely long neck and legs.

animals.name: Horse
animals.description: The horse is a domesticated mammal valued for its strength, speed, and companionship with humans.

animals.name: Zebra
animals.description: The zebra is an African equine known for its distinctive black-and-white striped coat.

animals.name: Deer
animals.description: The deer is a graceful hoofed mammal, with males of most species growing antlers.

animals.name: Antelope
animals.description: The antelope is a swift, slender-legged hoofed mammal found mainly in Africa and Asia.

animals.name: Elephant
animals.description: The elephant is the largest living land animal, known for its long trunk and large ears.

animals.name: Buffalo
animals.description: The buffalo is a large horned bovine known for its strength and role in grassland ecosystems.

animals.name: Dog
animals.description: The dog is a domesticated mammal known for its loyalty and companionship with humans.

animals.name: Dolphin
animals.description: The dolphin is a highly intelligent marine mammal known for its playful behavior and echolocation.

animals.name: Octopus
animals.description: The octopus is a marine mollusk with eight arms, known for its intelligence and ability to change color.

animals.name: Starfish
animals.description: The starfish is a star-shaped marine animal that can regenerate lost limbs.

animals.name: Blue Whale
animals.description: The blue whale is the largest animal known to have ever existed, living in oceans worldwide.

animals.name: Crab
animals.description: The crab is a crustacean with a hard shell known for walking sideways.

animals.name: Crocodile
animals.description: The crocodile is a large aquatic reptile known for its powerful jaws and armored skin.

animals.name: Turtle
animals.description: The turtle is a reptile with a protective shell, found in both aquatic and land habitats.

animals.name: Snake
animals.description: The snake is a legless reptile that moves by slithering and comes in many species worldwide.

animals.name: Gecko
animals.description: The gecko is a small lizard known for its ability to climb smooth surfaces and walls.

animals.name: Chameleon
animals.description: The chameleon is a lizard famous for its ability to change the color of its skin.
